policy: L3 藥物分類。課件(PPT)是這一層的主來源 —— PPT 教的正是機轉與作用部位。禁忌與交互作用課件為 0,不在這一層填。

records.name_zh: 袢利尿劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Prevent reabsorption of sodium and chloride in the loop of Henle, enhancing diuresis.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 阻止亨利氏環對鈉與氯的再吸收,增強利尿。
records.site_of_action_en: Thick ascending limb of the loop of Henle
indications_en: Short-term use for ascites and lymphedema
indications_zh: 腹水與淋巴水腫短期使用
records.mnemonic_en: Fast & Furious in the Loop [Hear No Evil]

records.name_zh: Thiazide 類利尿劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Inhibit the sodium-chloride symport in the ascending loop of Henle and distal convoluted tubule, producing excretion of sodium, chloride and water.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 抑制亨利氏環上行支與遠曲小管的鈉氯共同轉運,使鈉、氯與水排出而利尿。
records.site_of_action_en: Ascending loop of Henle and distal convoluted tubule
records.site_of_action_zh: 亨利氏環上行支與遠曲小管
indications_zh: 類固醇與雌激素治療相關水腫
shared_adverse_effects_zh: 體液與電解質過度流失
records.mnemonic_en: See No Evil — Short THIAZ for hypertension, Long THIAZ for diabetes

records.name_zh: 保鉀利尿劑
records.mnemonic_en: BANANAS — DARONE's brother ACTONE is kind & spares Potassium
records.exam_trap_en: Loop and thiazide diuretics cause hypokalemia; potassium-sparing diuretics cause HYPERkalemia. Do not confuse the two.
records.exam_trap_zh: 袢利尿劑與 thiazide 造成低血鉀,保鉀利尿劑造成高血鉀 —— 方向相反,考題最愛。
records.gap_note_zh: 課件對本類的機轉敘述較少,site_of_action 與 shared_adverse_effects 待官方標籤補。

records.name_zh: 碳酸酐酶抑制劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Inhibit carbonic anhydrase, causing excretion of sodium, potassium, bicarbonate and water. Also decrease production of aqueous humor and lower intraocular pressure.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 抑制碳酸酐酶,使鈉、鉀、碳酸氫根與水排出;並減少房水生成、降低眼壓。
records.adverse_effect_note_zh: 課件標明這些副作用見於「慢性使用」(chronic use)。

records.name_zh: 滲透性利尿劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Filtered at the glomerulus but not reabsorbed, so they raise the osmolarity of the filtrate; water is retained in the urine and urine volume increases.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 在腎絲球被過濾但不被再吸收,提高濾液滲透壓,使水留在尿中而增加尿量。
records.site_of_action_zh: 腎絲球與腎小管(滲透作用,非受體媒介)
records.target_note_zh: 無分子標的 —— 滲透作用不經受體,drugtarget_id 刻意留 null,不是待補。

records.name_zh: 維生素 K 拮抗劑
records.bleeding_risk_zh: 極高 —— 需 INR 監測;針刺前必須確認。

records.name_zh: P2Y12 抑制劑
records.bleeding_risk_zh: 高 —— 抗血小板,無常規監測指標。

records.name_zh: 直接 Xa 因子抑制劑
records.bleeding_risk_zh: 高 —— 無常規監測指標,不像 warfarin 有 INR。
records.class_boxed_warning_zh: 本類兩個藥(阿哌沙班、利伐沙班)的黑框警告結構相同:(A) 提早停藥增加血栓風險 (B) 神經軸麻醉/脊椎穿刺可能導致硬膜外或脊椎血腫與永久癱瘓。這是分類層級的事實,不是巧合。
records.monitoring_note_zh: 無常規監測指標 —— 這是 DOAC 與 warfarin 最大的臨床差別。看不到 INR 不代表出血風險較低。

records.name_zh: 直接凝血酶抑制劑
環氧化酶抑制型抗血小板藥
records.note_zh: 低劑量作抗血小板;高劑量進入 NSAID 範疇(P4)。同一分子兩種角色。

records.name_zh: 肝素類
血管緊張素 II 受體阻斷劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Selectively block angiotensin II binding to AT1 receptors, preventing vasoconstriction and aldosterone secretion.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 選擇性阻斷血管緊張素 II 與 AT1 受體結合，抑制血管收縮與醛固酮釋放。

records.name_zh: 血管緊張素轉換酶抑制劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Inhibit angiotensin-converting enzyme, blocking conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II and reducing aldosterone secretion.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 抑制血管緊張素轉換酶，阻斷血管緊張素 I 轉化為 II，並減少醛固酮分泌。
class_warnings_en: Boxed warning for fetal toxicity during pregnancy
36-hour washout required when switching to/from Sacubitril/Valsartan
class_warnings_zh: 懷孕期胎兒毒性黑框警告
與 Sacubitril/Valsartan 互換需 36 小時洗脫期
class_contraindications_zh: ACEi 相關血管神經性水腫病史
records.board_high_yield_en: Suffix -pril. Inhibits bradykinin degradation -> Dry cough & Angioedema. Fetal toxicity boxed warning. Renal protective in T2D nephropathy.
records.board_high_yield_zh: 字尾 -pril。抑制緩激肽降解 -> 乾咳與血管水腫。胎兒毒性黑框警告。第二型糖尿病腎病變具腎臟保護作用。
records.differentiating_notes_en: Unlike ARBs (-sartan), ACE inhibitors inhibit bradykinin breakdown causing dry cough in ~10-20% of patients.
records.differentiating_notes_zh: 與 ARB (-sartan) 不同，ACE 抑制劑會抑制緩激肽分解，約 10-20% 患者出現乾咳。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:ab561d21-7466-4d8b-8d06-291c1d4d82ff#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_en: Beta-1 selective adrenergic receptor blockers (Beta-1 selective blockers)
records.name_zh: Beta-1 選擇性受體阻斷劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Selectively block beta-1 adrenergic receptors in cardiac tissue, reducing heart rate, myocardial contractility, and blood pressure.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 選擇性阻斷心肌組織 beta-1 腎上腺素受體，降低心跳率、心肌收縮力與血壓。
class_warnings_en: Boxed warning against abrupt discontinuation (rebound angina/MI risk)
Beta-1 selectivity is dose-dependent and lost at high doses
class_warnings_zh: 突發停藥黑框警告（反彈性心絞痛/心肌梗塞風險）
Beta-1 選擇性具劑量依賴性，高劑量下會喪失
class_contraindications_zh: 二度或三度房室傳導阻滯
records.board_high_yield_en: Suffix -olol. Selective for heart (beta-1), preferred in asthma/COPD over nonselective blockers. Abrupt cessation causes rebound ischemia.
records.board_high_yield_zh: 字尾 -olol。心臟選擇性 (beta-1)，氣喘/COPD 患者較非選擇性安全。突發停藥引起反彈性缺血。
records.differentiating_notes_en: Metoprolol succinate, bisoprolol, and carvedilol are the 3 beta-blockers proven to reduce mortality in heart failure.
records.differentiating_notes_zh: 美托洛爾琥珀酸鹽、比索洛爾與卡維地洛為實證可降低心衰竭死亡率的三種 beta 阻斷劑。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:151079c5-6360-45ed-8118-885543d6a4ad#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 二氫吡啶類鈣離子通道阻斷劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Inhibit L-type calcium channels in vascular smooth muscle, causing peripheral arterial vasodilation.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 抑制血管平滑肌 L 型鈣通道，引起周邊動脈血管擴張。

records.name_zh: HMG-CoA 還原酶抑制劑 (他汀類)
records.mechanism_overview_en: Inhibit HMG-CoA reductase, the rate-limiting enzyme in cholesterol synthesis, upregulating hepatic LDL receptors.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 抑制膽固醇合成關鍵酶 HMG-CoA 還原酶，上調肝臟 LDL 受體。
indications_zh: 高風險患者心血管疾病之預防

records.name_zh: 強心苷類
records.mechanism_overview_en: Inhibit Na+/K+-ATPase pump in cardiomyocytes, increasing intracellular sodium and secondary calcium influx to enhance contractility.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 抑制心肌細胞 Na+/K+-ATPase 泵，增加細胞內鈉與次級鈣流入以增強收縮力。

records.name_zh: Beta-2 選擇性腎上腺素受體致劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Selectively stimulate beta-2 adrenergic receptors in bronchial smooth muscle, causing bronchodilation.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 選擇性刺激支氣管平滑肌 beta-2 受體，引起支氣管擴張。
class_warnings_en: Risk of paradoxical bronchospasm; overreliance on short-acting agents indicates poor asthma control.
class_warnings_zh: 反常性支氣管痙攣風險；過度依賴短效劑型代表氣喘控制不良。
records.board_high_yield_en: Suffix -terol. Beta-2 = lungs. SABA rescue inhaler (albuterol) for acute bronchospasm. Tremor & tachycardia adverse effects.
records.board_high_yield_zh: 字尾 -terol。Beta-2 作用於肺部。SABA 救急吸入劑 (albuterol) 用於急性支氣管痙攣。副作用為震顫與心律過速。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:583c6408-45cc-9121-e063-6294a90afcc4#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 抗膽鹼 / 抗毒蕈鹼藥物
records.mechanism_overview_en: Competitively block muscarinic acetylcholine receptors, inhibiting parasympathetic impulses.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 競爭性阻斷毒蕈鹼型乙醯膽鹼受體，抑制副交感神經傳導。
class_warnings_en: Anticholinergic toxicity toxidrome; caution in elderly and patients with prostatic hyperplasia.
class_warnings_zh: 抗膽鹼毒性症候群；老年人及攝護腺肥大患者慎用。
records.board_high_yield_en: Classic toxidrome: 'Blind as a bat, mad as a hatter, red as a beet, hot as a hare, dry as a bone'. Atropine is prototype.
records.board_high_yield_zh: 經典中毒口訣：盲如蝙蝠、瘋如帽匠、紅如甜菜、熱如野兔、乾如枯骨。阿托品為代表藥。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:a116af5c-ba4c-408c-9a02-4bc33772aa8d#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: Alpha-1 選擇性腎上腺素受體阻斷劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Selectively inhibit alpha-1 adrenergic receptors, relaxing vascular smooth muscle and prostatic smooth muscle.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 選擇性抑制 alpha-1 腎上腺素受體，使血管平滑肌與攝護腺平滑肌鬆弛。
indications_zh: PTSD 創傷後壓力症夢魘 (prazosin)
class_warnings_en: First-dose effect: severe orthostatic hypotension and syncope after initial dose. Take at bedtime.
class_warnings_zh: 首劑效應：初始給藥後易發生嚴重姿勢性低血壓與暈厥。建議睡前服藥。
class_contraindications_zh: 對 alpha-1 阻斷劑過敏。
records.board_high_yield_en: Suffix -osin. Alpha-1 = vascular constriction. Prazosin cause first-dose syncope; tamsulosin selective for prostate BPH.
records.board_high_yield_zh: 字尾 -osin。Alpha-1 主導血管收縮。Prazosin 引起首劑暈厥；tamsulosin 具攝護腺選擇性用於 BPH。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:2f86fc8e-71c1-4749-b67e-86d86cf1d984#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_en: Non-Selective Beta-1 and Beta-2 Adrenergic Blockers
records.name_zh: 非選擇性 Beta-1 及 Beta-2 腎上腺素受體阻斷劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Block both beta-1 (cardiac) and beta-2 (bronchial/vascular) adrenergic receptors.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 同時阻斷 beta-1 (心臟) 與 beta-2 (支氣管/血管) 腎上腺素受體。
class_warnings_en: Contraindicated in asthma and severe COPD due to beta-2 blockade induced bronchospasm; abrupt withdrawal boxed warning.
class_warnings_zh: 氣喘及嚴重 COPD 患者禁忌（Beta-2 阻斷引致支氣管痙攣）；突發停藥黑框警告。
class_contraindications_zh: 二度/三度房室傳導阻滯
records.board_high_yield_en: Propranolol is prototype. Nonselective beta-blockade causes bronchospasm -> DO NOT use in asthmatics. Migraine & essential tremor uses.
records.board_high_yield_zh: Propranolol 為代表藥。非選擇性阻斷導致支氣管痙攣 -> 氣喘患者禁用。亦用於偏頭痛預防與原發性顫抖症。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:1cd914b6-b250-4b11-8404-41db3589361e#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 中樞 Alpha-2 腎上腺素受體致劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Stimulate presynaptic alpha-2 receptors in the brainstem, decreasing central sympathetic outflow.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 刺激腦幹突觸前 alpha-2 受體，降低中樞交感神經衝動輸出。
class_warnings_en: Abrupt discontinuation causes severe rebound hypertension due to rapid surge in catecholamines.
class_warnings_zh: 突然停藥會因兒茶酚胺劇增而引致嚴重反彈性高血壓。
records.board_high_yield_en: Clonidine central sympatholytic. Reduces sympathetic outflow. WARNING: Abrupt withdrawal = rebound hypertensive crisis.
records.board_high_yield_zh: Clonidine 為中樞交感抑制劑。降低交感輸出。警告：突發停藥導致反彈性高血壓危機。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:8171776a-dd14-4dcc-8860-3c27d8ea9504#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 乙醛脫氫酶抑制劑 / 戒酒輔助藥物
records.mechanism_overview_en: Inhibit aldehyde dehydrogenase, preventing metabolism of acetaldehyde to acetic acid after ethanol intake.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 抑制乙醛脫氫酶，阻斷乙醇代謝中間產物乙醛轉化為乙酸。
indications_zh: 酒精依賴 / 酒精使用障礙
shared_adverse_effects_en: Disulfiram-alcohol reaction (flushing, nausea, vomiting, throbbing headache, hypotension)
shared_adverse_effects_zh: 雙硫崙-酒精反應 (面部潮紅、噁心、嘔吐、劇烈頭痛、低血壓)
class_warnings_en: Boxed warning: Never administer to patient who is intoxicated or without their full consent and knowledge.
class_warnings_zh: 黑框警告：絕不可在患者醉酒或未知情同意下給藥。
class_contraindications_en: Use of alcohol or alcohol-containing products
class_contraindications_zh: 使用酒精或含酒精製品
records.board_high_yield_en: Disulfiram blocks ALDH -> acetaldehyde accumulation. Causes severe flushing/nausea with alcohol. Also metronidazole disulfiram-like reaction.
records.board_high_yield_zh: Disulfiram 阻斷 ALDH -> 乙醛蓄積。飲酒引起嚴重潮紅噁心。Metronidazole 亦具雙硫崙樣反應。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:d3832a1a-a140-49c1-a7df-134fa81341e3#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 乙內醯脲類抗癲癇藥物
records.mechanism_overview_en: Block voltage-gated sodium channels, stabilizing neuronal membranes and inhibiting seizure spread.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 阻斷電壓門控鈉離子通道，穩定神經元膜並抑制癲癇發作擴散。
indications_zh: 強直陣攣性發作 (大發作)
局灶性 (部分性) 發作
class_warnings_en: Boxed warning for IV infusion rate (hypotension & arrhythmia risk); strong CYP450 inducer; non-linear saturation kinetics.
class_warnings_zh: 靜脈注射速率黑框警告 (低血壓與心律不整風險)；強效 CYP450 誘導劑；非線性飽和動力學。
class_contraindications_zh: 二度/三度竇房或房室傳導阻滯
records.board_high_yield_en: Phenytoin is prototype. Zero-order saturation kinetics. Classic adverse effect triad: Gingival hyperplasia, nystagmus, ataxia. INEFFECTIVE for absence seizures.
records.board_high_yield_zh: Phenytoin 為代表藥。零級飽和動力學。經典副作用三聯徵：齒齦增生、眼球震顫、共濟失調。對失神發作無效。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:ef4e97a7-cd18-47a9-a016-2eca5481a87e#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 亞胺茋類抗癲癇藥物
records.mechanism_overview_en: Block voltage-dependent sodium channels, reducing repetitive neuronal firing.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 阻斷電壓依賴性鈉離子通道，減少高頻重複神經放電。
shared_adverse_effects_zh: 史蒂芬斯-強森症候群皮疹
class_warnings_en: Boxed warnings: Aplastic anemia & agranulocytosis; Serious dermatologic reactions (HLA-B*1502 screening required). Potent CYP3A4 auto-inducer.
class_warnings_zh: 黑框警告：再生不良性貧血與顆粒性白血球缺乏症；嚴重皮膚反應 (HLA-B*1502 篩檢)。強效 CYP3A4 自體誘導劑。
records.board_high_yield_en: Carbamazepine 1st line for trigeminal neuralgia. Aplastic anemia boxed warning. Auto-induces CYP metabolism. Test HLA-B*1502 in Asians.
records.board_high_yield_zh: Carbamazepine 為三叉神經痛首選。再生不良性貧血黑框警告。自體誘導 CYP 代謝。亞洲人須篩檢 HLA-B*1502。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:52cf3ba9-0a7c-4809-830e-af93d1532726#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 琥珀醯亞胺類抗失神癲癇藥物
records.mechanism_overview_en: Block T-type voltage-gated calcium channels in thalamic neurons, suppressing 3-Hz spike-and-wave discharges.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 阻斷丘腦神經元 T 型電壓門控鈣通道，抑制 3-Hz 棘慢波異常放電。
class_warnings_en: Risk of serious blood dyscrasias and SJS/TEN.
class_warnings_zh: 嚴重血液疾病與史蒂芬斯-強森症候群風險。
records.board_high_yield_en: Ethosuximide is PROTOTYPE for absence (petit mal) seizures ('EFG - Ethosuximide for Absence'). Blocks thalamic T-type Ca channels.
records.board_high_yield_zh: Ethosuximide 為失神 (小發作) 癲癇代表藥 (口訣 'EFG - Ethosuximide for Petit Mal')。阻斷丘腦 T 型鈣通道。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:19c924c2-f558-4c78-9277-2d7e0df2f505#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 加巴噴丁類藥物 (Alpha-2-Delta 鈣通道配體)
records.mechanism_overview_en: Bind to the alpha-2-delta subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels in the CNS, decreasing excitatory neurotransmitter release.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 結合至中樞電壓門控鈣通道 alpha-2-delta 亞基，減少興奮性神經傳遞物質釋放。
class_warnings_en: Risk of severe respiratory depression when co-administered with opioids or CNS depressants.
class_warnings_zh: 與鴉片類或中樞抑制劑併用時具嚴重呼吸抑制風險。
records.board_high_yield_en: Gabapentin & pregabalin. Structurally related to GABA but DO NOT bind GABA receptors. Primary use is neuropathic pain & postherpetic neuralgia.
records.board_high_yield_zh: Gabapentin 與 pregabalin。結構與 GABA 相似但不結合 GABA 受體。主用於神經痛與帶狀皰疹後神經痛。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:507bf6d0-e7a2-413d-9848-cd2445a1411d#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 多巴胺前驅物與去羧酶抑制劑複方藥物
records.mechanism_overview_en: Levodopa crosses the BBB and converts to dopamine; carbidopa inhibits peripheral dopa decarboxylase to prevent peripheral metabolism.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 左旋多巴通過血腦障壁轉化為多巴胺；卡比多巴抑制外周多巴去羧酶，防止外周代謝並降低副作用。
indications_zh: 腦炎後帕金森氏症候群
class_warnings_en: Long-term therapy produces motor fluctuations (wearing-off and on-off phenomenon). Contraindicated with nonselective MAOIs.
class_warnings_zh: 長期治療引發運動波動現象（藥效消退與開關現象）。非選擇性 MAOI 併用禁忌。
class_contraindications_zh: 未確診的疑似黑素瘤皮膚病變
records.board_high_yield_en: Levodopa + Carbidopa (Sinemet) is 1st line for Parkinson's. Carbidopa prevents peripheral L-dopa breakdown. Long-term use -> 'on-off' dyskinesia.
records.board_high_yield_zh: Levodopa + Carbidopa (Sinemet) 為帕金森氏症首選。Carbidopa 阻止外周 L-dopa 破壞。長期使用導致『開關』運動障礙。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:4ace5274-b6cf-414c-b9c0-f60e28a9cea5#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 單胺氧化酶抑制劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Inhibit monoamine oxidase enzymes (MAO-A and/or MAO-B), preventing breakdown of norepinephrine, serotonin, and dopamine.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 抑制單胺氧化酶 (MAO-A 及/或 MAO-B)，阻止正腎上腺素、血清素及多巴胺降解。
indications_en: Parkinson's disease (MAO-B selective agents like selegiline)
indications_zh: 非典型 / 難治性憂鬱症
帕金森氏症 (MAO-B 選擇性劑如 selegiline)
shared_adverse_effects_zh: 高血壓危機 (併用含酪胺食物)
血清素症候群 (併用 SSRI/SNRI)
class_warnings_en: Boxed warning: Suicidality in children/young adults. Dietary tyramine restriction required for nonselective MAOIs to avoid fatal hypertensive crisis. 14-day washout period.
class_warnings_zh: 黑框警告：青少年自殺風險。非選擇性 MAOI 須嚴格限制飲食酪胺以防致命高血壓危機。換藥須 14 天洗脫期。
class_contraindications_en: Co-administration with SSRIs, SNRIs, meperidine, dextromethorphan, or sympathomimetics
class_contraindications_zh: 併用 SSRI、SNRI、Meperidine、Dextromethorphan 或交感神經刺激劑
records.board_high_yield_en: Phenelzine is nonselective prototype. Tyramine food reaction -> severe hypertensive crisis ('cheese reaction'). Requires 14-day washout before SSRIs.
records.board_high_yield_zh: Phenelzine 為非選擇性代表藥。酪胺食物反應 -> 嚴重高血壓危機 ('乳酪效應')。使用 SSRI 前須 14 天洗脫期。

class_warnings_en: dailymed:fa041652-fdde-4794-a8d2-279dd309e075#WARNINGS_AND_PRECAUTIONS

records.name_zh: 升糖素樣胜肽-1 受體促效劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Activate GLP-1 receptors to stimulate glucose-dependent insulin secretion, suppress glucagon, slow gastric emptying, and reduce appetite. Also have cardiovascular and renal protective effects.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 激活GLP-1受體，促進葡萄糖依賴性胰島素分泌，抑制升糖素，延緩胃排空，降低食慾。亦有心血管與腎臟保護效果。
indications_en: Reduction of major cardiovascular events in selected patients
indications_zh: 第二型糖尿病血糖控制
降低特定患者主要心血管事件風險
慢性體重管理（依產品適應症）
shared_adverse_effects_en: Thyroid C-cell tumor (boxed warning in Ozempic label; contraindicated in MTC/MEN2 history)
shared_adverse_effects_zh: 噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉（非常常見）
甲狀腺C細胞腫瘤（Ozempic黑框警語；MTC/MEN2病史禁用）

records.name_zh: 甲狀腺素替代藥
records.mechanism_overview_en: Exogenous thyroid hormone (T4) binds nuclear thyroid hormone receptors, restoring euthyroid metabolic state. Excess T4 is peripherally converted to active T3.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 外源性甲狀腺素（T4）結合核內甲狀腺素受體，恢復正常甲狀腺功能代謝狀態。過量T4在周邊組織轉化為活性T3。
records.site_of_action_en: Nuclear thyroid hormone receptors in heart, liver, bone, pituitary
records.site_of_action_zh: 心臟、肝臟、骨骼、腦垂體的核內甲狀腺素受體
indications_en: Thyroid-stimulating hormone suppression in selected thyroid conditions
indications_zh: 甲狀腺功能低下（原發性與繼發性）
特定甲狀腺疾病的促甲狀腺素抑制
shared_adverse_effects_en: Boxed warning: not for use in obesity or weight loss
shared_adverse_effects_zh: 顫抖、耐熱能力下降（過量）
長期過量導致骨質流失
黑框警語：不得用於肥胖或減重

records.name_zh: 全身性糖皮質激素
records.mechanism_overview_en: Bind intracellular glucocorticoid receptors, translocate to nucleus, and modulate gene transcription producing broad anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressive effects; also exert metabolic, cardiovascular, and CNS effects.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 結合細胞內糖皮質激素受體，轉位至細胞核調節基因轉錄，產生廣泛的抗炎與免疫抑制效果；同時有代謝、心血管及中樞神經系統效應。
records.site_of_action_zh: 全身細胞內糖皮質激素受體
indications_zh: 腎上腺功能不全替代療法
shared_adverse_effects_zh: 免疫抑制，增加感染風險
長期使用導致腎上腺抑制

records.name_zh: 非二氫吡啶類鈣通道阻滯劑
records.mechanism_overview_en: Block L-type voltage-gated calcium channels in cardiac and vascular smooth muscle, but with greater effect on cardiac conduction (AV node) and heart rate than dihydropyridines. Reduce HR, slow AV conduction, and reduce contractility.
records.mechanism_overview_zh: 阻斷心臟與血管平滑肌L型電壓門控鈣通道，但對心臟傳導（房室結）與心率的影響大於二氫吡啶類。降低心率、延緩房室傳導、減少心肌收縮力。
records.site_of_action_en: L-type calcium channels in sinoatrial and atrioventricular nodes, cardiac muscle, and vascular smooth muscle
records.site_of_action_zh: 竇房結與房室結、心肌、血管平滑肌的L型鈣通道
indications_zh: 上心室心動過速（頻率控制）
心房顫動/撲動的頻率控制
shared_adverse_effects_en: Bradycardia and heart block (high-yield: dangerous in combination with beta-blockers)
shared_adverse_effects_zh: 心跳過緩與心臟傳導阻滯（高度重要：與β阻斷劑合用有危險）
